name: Week 38 Pull — Pull-Ups and Lat Pulldown Take the Spotlight
description: Same pull day, same loads. The pull-ups and the lat pulldown share the spotlight; the pull-ups take a slow lowering. The high cable curl runs on the regular pulley with the S handle at 62.5. The DB row pyramid holds. The warmup rotates thread-the-needle to arm circles; the band pull-apart, the bicep pre-load and the shrug stay.

dayOverview.theme: Same pull day at the same length. The two vertical pulls get the spotlight: shoulders packed down before the elbows bend, and a slow way back up.

spotlights.why: 4 sets of 6-8 with a 3-second lowering. Pack down first, chest to the bar, and a controlled descent to an active hang.
180 on the regular machine for 3 x 8-12. Start from the armpits and let the bar pull you into a real stretch on the way up.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: Spotlights go to the incline curl and the DB row next.
watchpoints: 🛑 keep it shy — the cue is the cap: pull-ups, DB row, chest-supported row, lat pulldown, incline curl. Grip and position lifts where the honest ceiling is the rep the cue breaks.
🔥 near-failure last set OK: reverse fly, face pull, high cable curl, cable crunch. Isolation work where form holds at the limit.
**⭐ IF THE SHOULDERS CRACKLE, TAKE THE SHRUG AGAIN BETWEEN PULL-UP SETS.** It is the same behind-back shrug from the warmup, with a kettlebell or a DB pair. Optional, not a mandatory round.
**Say which shoulder** if either gets noisy. Mention any tiredness that ends a set.
**The incline curl is CHEST-SUPPORTED, PREACHER-STYLE.** Bench a notch steeper than 45°, armpit and the back of the upper arm flat on the pad, arm hanging down the face of the pad.

**The left curl spot:** a twinge on set 1 that clears by set 2 is the pattern you know. Stop the curl if it does not clear by set 2, if it is sharper than before, or if it is still there the next morning, and say so.
Log both sides on the DB row: where the left and right end on the 95.
**Band-pull-apart is the pull-day shoulder anchor.** Keep the warmup lean — no extra band volume.

**Two rows, so the shoulders and grip get a second round of work.** Do the DB row pyramid first; the chest-supported row is the lighter, supported one, and the first thing to cut if the shoulder talks.
**Lat pulldown: the regular machine first.** If the dual pulley feels sticky, leave it and wait for the regular machine.

sets.name: Warmup (Pull-Up Bar Station) + Bicep Pre-Load
sets.notes: Lean by design. **The bicep pre-load stays** — a light set plus one still hold, before anything hangs off the elbow. **Note where the shrug is: you will want it again between pull-up sets.**

exercises.notes: **The shoulder anchor for pull day.** Light band, slow, squeeze the blades together without shrugging.
Big, slow circles, forward then back. **Shoulders stay down while the arms go round.** Wakes the shoulder before the bar.
Deep core before anything loaded.
Passive hang. **Your first read on both shoulders today** — note whether either one is noisy, and which.

**It helped, so it stays.**
- **Light DBs, nowhere near failure, left side first**
- **Then hold a light DB still at about 90° for 30 seconds on the left**, and the same on the right
- The hold is the point: a still, moderate load is the calmest thing you can hand an irritable tendon, and it goes in before the bar takes your bodyweight

**Protective activation — do this before anything loaded.** 40-50lb pair or a kettlebell, behind the back, straight up and down, squeeze at the top.

**This is the same movement you will reach for between pull-up sets if the shoulders crackle.** Know where the weight is before you start.

sets.name: 🔆 Pull-Ups — 4 Sets, 3s Lowering, Shrug Reset When Needed 🛑
sets.notes:
Bodyweight, 4 sets of 6-8, straight bar, full 2-minute rests. **A 3-second lowering on every rep.** If the slow lowering ends a set early, finish that set as slow singles.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — packed at the top, slow on the way down.**

- **Active hang to start**, shoulders pulled down away from the ears
- **Pack down before the elbows bend**, then pull the elbows to the ribs with the chest leading
- **Chest toward the bar**, chin clears it without craning the neck
- **Count 3 on the way down**, shoulders staying packed until the arms are long
- **Back to an active hang** at the bottom, not a collapsed one
- Use the behind-back shrug between sets only if a shoulder gets noisy, and say which one

**Reflection:** on the last set, which went first — the pull to the bar, or the slow lowering?

exercises.notes:
Bodyweight, 4 sets, **3s lowering.** Straight bar, 2 min rest.
- Pack down before the elbows bend
- Count 3 down to an active hang
- Slow singles to finish a set if the lowering goes
- **Shrug reset between sets if the shoulders crackle; say which shoulder**

sets.name: DB Rack / Bench Block — Incline Curl → DB Row (3 Rounds)
sets.notes:
Both movements stay at one adjustable bench. **Left first on the curl.** The row pyramid stays at 75 → 85 → 95, one set each side per round; record where each side ends on the 95.

**The left curl spot:** the 25s are the load. A twinge on set 1 that clears by set 2 is the pattern you know. **Stop the curl** if it does not clear by set 2, if it is sharper than before, or if it is still there the next morning, and say so.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 25lb both arms, 3 sets of 10 each side, plus one easy left-side warm-up set. Left first.

- Bench a notch steeper than 45°, upper arm flat on the pad the whole rep
- Slow eccentric; never drop into the bottom
- **Stop if the set-1 twinge does not clear by set 2 or is sharper than before**

**LOAD:** pyramid **75 → 85 → 95**, one set each side per round, 8-10 each side.

- **Chest supported on the bench**, spine long, hips square
- **Shoulder blade back first**, then the elbow drives past the ribs toward the hip
- **No twisting to finish**; slow down to a full stretch

sets.name: Bench Block, Second Half — Chest-Supported Row → Reverse Fly (2 Rounds)
sets.notes:
**Two rounds.** Same bench, set to a low incline.

- **Chest glued to the pad**; start every rep with the shoulder blades
- **3 seconds down** to a full stretch
- Reverse fly: soft fixed elbows, shoulders packed down

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 45lb pair, 2 sets of 12, slow eccentric.
- **Chest stays glued to the pad**
- **Start the rep with the shoulder blades**
- **Elbows past the ribs at ~45°**
- **3s down** to a full stretch

**LOAD:** 20lb pair, 2 sets of 12-15, slow eccentric.
- **Soft elbows at a fixed angle** — bending and straightening turns it into a row
- **Lead with the pinkies**, thumbs down
- **Shoulders packed DOWN** — the traps want this one badly
- Slow all the way back down
- Last set may run near failure 🔥

sets.name: 🔆 Lat Pulldown — Regular Machine 180 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 3 sets of 8-12, slow eccentric. **Log the station:**
- Regular machine: **180** — first choice
- Dual cable pulley: **80 per side**, only if it runs smoothly

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — start from the armpits.**

- **Thighs locked under the pad**, chest up, ribs down
- **Pack the shoulders down before the elbows move**
- **Pull the elbows down to the ribs**, bar to the top of the chest, no leaning back
- **A beat at the bottom** with the lats squeezed
- **Let the bar pull you up slowly into a real stretch**, shoulders rising only at the very top

**Reflection:** on set 3, did the shoulders still pack down first, or did the arms start the pull?

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** regular machine 180; dual pulley 80/side if it runs smoothly.
- Pack down before the elbows bend
- Start from the armpits
- Chest up, ribs down, no leaning back
- Slow eccentric to a full stretch

sets.name: Face Pull — 62.5 or 65 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 62.5 or 65 on the rope — whichever the stack lands on. 3 sets of 20.

- **Elbows high**, hands finish beside the ears
- **Knuckles rotate back** at the end of every rep, a beat there
- Traps quiet; no shrug, no lean back

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 62.5 or 65, whichever the stack lands on.
- Hands finish beside the ears, **elbows high**
- **Knuckles rotate back** at the end of every rep
- Hold a beat, slow return
- Elbows lead, hands follow, traps quiet

sets.name: High Cable Curl — Regular Pulley + S Handle 62.5 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** regular pulley with the S handle, 62.5, 4 sets of 12 each side. **If it is taken:** the cable column at 220 / 230 / 240 / 250. Log the station.

- **Elbow fixed at shoulder height**; only the forearm moves
- **Left first**, squeeze at the top, slow return
- Last set may run near failure 🔥

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** regular pulley + S handle 62.5, 4 sets; cable column 220 / 230 / 240 / 250 if the pulley is taken. Log the station.
- Single arm, elbow fixed at shoulder height
- Left first
- Squeeze at the top, slow return

sets.name: Cable Crunch 🔥
sets.notes: Same cable stations as the curl. Pick by availability and log which; the two scales do not convert.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:**
- Regular pulley, rope or D handle: **77.5** (82.5 is the ceiling)
- Cable column: **150**
Pick by availability and **log which**.

- **Curl the spine, don't hinge the hips** — the hips stay put and the ribs come toward the pelvis
- **Slow return**, resist all the way back up
- Arms are hooks, not levers
- Last set may run near failure 🔥

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Fascia/Recovery Block
sets.notes: Five minutes, every gym day. Slow breathing throughout — the downshift is as much the point as the tissue.

exercises.notes: 30s each arm, elbow at MID height.
Passive. Let the shoulders decompress after the pulling.
30s each side.
45s each side.
Slow breathing. End here.

tips: Pull-ups: four sets at normal tempo, packed down. Fast and clean is fine.
DB row: 75 → 85 → 95, elbow past the ribs.
Chest-supported row: two sets; chest glued to the pad, slow on the way down.
Face pull: 62.5 or 65, whichever the stack lands on. Elbows high, knuckles back.
Left curl spot: stop if the set-1 twinge does not clear by set 2, is sharper than before, or is still there the next morning.
Pulldown: regular machine 180 or dual pulley 80/side. Log which.
